# Full Coverage Checklist: 数据集页面按需访问 RAG 系统

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation across UX, API contract, edge cases, and non-functional dimensions for the Datasets page on-demand RAG access feature.

**Created**: 2026-08-22

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are loading state requirements defined for every async resource fetch (connections, assistants, knowledge bases) in both task creation and AI generation modals? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are empty-state requirements specified for when a connection returns zero assistants or zero knowledge bases? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are empty-state requirements specified for when the connection list itself is empty (no configured connections)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for what happens when both task creation and AI generation modals are triggered simultaneously or in rapid succession? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the "inline error with retry button" UI pattern specified with exact content, placement, and retry behavior for connection list failures? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are accessibility requirements (keyboard navigation, screen reader labels, focus management) specified for the modal session flows? [Gap, Coverage]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "骨架占位符" (skeleton placeholder) defined with specific shape, count, and animation behavior, or is it left to implementation discretion? [Clarity, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK008 - FR-011 states knowledge base mode is binary (required/optional), but data-model.md defines `knowledge_base_selection_mode` as `'all' | 'selected' | 'none' | null`. Which is authoritative — the spec's binary simplification or the data model's four-value enum? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the specific UI states for each `knowledge_base_selection_mode` value defined: what does the form show for 'all', 'none', 'selected', and null? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the connection capability badge display format specified (icon, text, color, position) for the `generate_dataset_from_knowledge_base` flag? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the "明确原因" (explicit reason) text specified for when a connection lacks AI generation capability? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the term "按需" (on-demand) quantified with specific trigger events, or does it only mean "not on page load"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-016]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Do the edge case "已选择的连接被停用、删除或失去权限时，提交操作必须重新验证" and FR-013 (re-validation before submit) align on exactly what re-validation entails? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 - Does FR-022 (modal close clears state) align with the edge case "用户从数据集行进入任务创建后关闭弹窗，重新打开时不得保留另一数据集或另一连接的过期资源选择"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 - Assumption "评测任务创建继续使用共享的连接感知任务表单" — is this the `EvaluationTaskForm` component, and do its existing requirements remain unchanged or are they superseded by FR-007 through FR-014? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are the session state tables in data-model.md consistent with all FR cleanup requirements (FR-012, FR-019, FR-022)? Specifically, does every state field listed have a corresponding reset requirement? [Consistency, data-model.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 - SC-009 states "5 秒内打开数据集页面并执行列表、上传、预览或删除操作" — are network conditions and hardware assumptions specified for this 5-second target? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK018 - SC-010 states "至少 90% 的测试用户能在首次尝试中正确选择连接" — is this a usability study metric rather than a system-level acceptance criterion? If so, what is the equivalent system-level measurable outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK019 - SC-011 states connection list loads "在 2 秒内完成加载并渲染为可交互状态" — is this measured from modal open event or from API request initiation? Is it a p50, p95, or p99 target? [Clarity, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK020 - Can SC-001 ("100% of page loads produce 0 RAG requests") be objectively verified without access to backend server logs, or is it purely a client-side network tab observation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a user opens a modal, selects a connection, then the connection's status changes to 'unavailable' mid-session before submit? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where the AI generation API returns a partial success (generation started but some samples failed)? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where the user navigates away from the Datasets page (browser back, route change) while a modal is open with in-flight requests? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK024 - Does the spec address the scenario where an assistant's `allowed_knowledge_base_ids` restricts which KBs are selectable, and is this filtering requirement specified? [Gap, data-model.md AssistantRef]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are concurrent connection switch edge cases addressed: what happens if the user rapidly switches connections 5+ times before any assistant response arrives? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 - Is the edge case "AI 数据集生成连接在弹窗打开后失去生成能力" mapped to a specific functional requirement, or does it only exist in the edge cases section? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the behavior specified when the user retries a failed connection list load and it fails again? Is there a retry limit or escalation path? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements specified for what happens when the dataset list refresh (polling) coincides with a modal open, and both make concurrent API calls? [Gap, Coverage]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 - Are memory/performance requirements specified for AbortController cleanup to prevent listener leaks across repeated modal open/close cycles? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements specified for the maximum number of connections, assistants, or knowledge bases the UI must handle before pagination or virtualization is needed? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 - Is the assumption "连接能力是后端返回的权威信息；页面不根据系统名称猜测能力" validated — does the backend guarantee the capability fields are always present and never null? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the assumption "资源列表不在数据集页面加载时预缓存" validated against potential future optimization requests that might contradict this design constraint? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
